a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve has only 4 cells, so at most one of us can be safe right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. With an 80% storm risk each round, waiting for 8 cells would most likely kill us both. If I end up with extra cells, I'll give them back to the reserve for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
